whyUseDrones.headline: Why Use Drones for As-Built Surveys?

items.title: Precision Mapping
items.description: Generate true-to-scale digital blueprints using high-resolution orthomosaics and 3D reconstructions.

items.title: Speed & Efficiency
items.description: Survey vast construction zones in record time, improving timelines and reducing rework.

items.title: Environmental Monitoring
items.description: Visualize ecological change and monitor conservation areas.
items.popupContent: Using UAVs, SmartGrid tracks land cover change, deforestation, erosion, and other ecological indicators. Our data supports impact assessments and regulatory compliance with repeatable, time-stamped visuals.

items.title: Seamless Integration
items.description: Compatible outputs for CAD, Revit, GIS, and all major BIM platforms.

items.title: Site Planning
items.description: Our engineers assess the environment and establish drone flight logistics and control stations.

items.title: Drone Data Capture
items.description: We deploy drones equipped with photogrammetry or LiDAR sensors to capture as-built surface conditions.

items.title: 3D Model Generation
items.description: Collected data is processed into interactive 3D models and geo-referenced layers.

items.title: Final Survey Delivery
items.description: Receive actionable deliverables that feed directly into your construction management tools.
